item.title: Am I spreading a mind virus when I help others use Claude?
item.summary: I’ve been thinking about this for a while inspired partly by the point of Sapiens how wheat domesticated humans, and also that show Pluribus, but the other day I helped my elderly father in law learn to use it and got me wondering… am I now just doing its bidding?
